section_summary.extract_value: This section (Study X) describes a single sample of 186 female college students from two private Christian colleges in the Northeast. The sample had a mean age of 19.9 (SD = 2.01), mean BMI of 22.7 (SD = 3.83), and was predominantly White (89.3%); no measures of body appreciation, nor correlations between body appreciation and BMI, are reported in this section.
